thm problem_17:
    ? forall point_a, point_b, point_c, point_d, center_gamma, center_1, center_2, center_3, touch_ab, touch_bc, touch_ca cart(R, R), radius_gamma, radius_1, radius_2, radius_3, line_ab_a, line_ab_b, line_ab_c, line_cd_a, line_cd_b, line_cd_c R:

        $f0::is_midpoint(center_gamma, point_a, point_b)

        f0::distance_sq(center_gamma, point_b) = radius_gamma ^ 2
        f0::distance_sq(center_gamma, point_c) = radius_gamma ^ 2
        point_c != point_a
        point_c != point_b
        $f0::is_on_line(point_d, point_a, point_b)
        $f0::is_perpendicular(point_c, point_d, point_a, point_b)
        radius_1 > 0
        radius_2 > 0
        radius_3 > 0
        line_ab_a ^ 2 + line_ab_b ^ 2 > 0
        line_ab_a * point_a(1) + line_ab_b * point_a(2) + line_ab_c = 0
        line_ab_a * point_b(1) + line_ab_b * point_b(2) + line_ab_c = 0
        $f0::circle_tangent_to_line(center_1, radius_1, line_ab_a, line_ab_b, line_ab_c)
        $f0::circle_tangent_to_line(center_2, radius_2, line_ab_a, line_ab_b, line_ab_c)
        $f0::circle_tangent_to_line(center_3, radius_3, line_ab_a, line_ab_b, line_ab_c)
        $f0::is_on_segment(touch_ab, point_a, point_b)
        f0::distance_sq(center_1, touch_ab) = radius_1 ^ 2
        $f0::is_perpendicular(center_1, touch_ab, point_a, point_b)
        $f0::is_on_segment(touch_bc, point_b, point_c)
        f0::distance_sq(center_1, touch_bc) = radius_1 ^ 2
        $f0::is_perpendicular(center_1, touch_bc, point_b, point_c)
        $f0::is_on_segment(touch_ca, point_c, point_a)
        f0::distance_sq(center_1, touch_ca) = radius_1 ^ 2
        $f0::is_perpendicular(center_1, touch_ca, point_c, point_a)
        line_cd_a ^ 2 + line_cd_b ^ 2 > 0
        line_cd_a * point_c(1) + line_cd_b * point_c(2) + line_cd_c = 0
        line_cd_a * point_d(1) + line_cd_b * point_d(2) + line_cd_c = 0
        $f0::circle_tangent_to_line(center_2, radius_2, line_cd_a, line_cd_b, line_cd_c)
        $f0::circle_tangent_to_line(center_3, radius_3, line_cd_a, line_cd_b, line_cd_c)
        (line_cd_a * center_2(1) + line_cd_b * center_2(2) + line_cd_c) * (line_cd_a * center_3(1) + line_cd_b * center_3(2) + line_cd_c) < 0
        $f0::circle_internally_tangent_to_semicircle(center_2, radius_2, center_gamma, radius_gamma, point_a, point_b, point_c)
        $f0::circle_internally_tangent_to_semicircle(center_3, radius_3, center_gamma, radius_gamma, point_a, point_b, point_c)
        =>:
            exist tangent_a, tangent_b, tangent_c R st {$f0::line_is_external_common_tangent(tangent_a, tangent_b, tangent_c, center_1, radius_1, center_2, radius_2), $f0::line_is_external_common_tangent(tangent_a, tangent_b, tangent_c, center_1, radius_1, center_3, radius_3), $f0::lines_are_distinct(tangent_a, tangent_b, tangent_c, line_ab_a, line_ab_b, line_ab_c)}
    thm coordinate_determinant_value_17:
        ? forall a, b, s cart(R, R):
            f0::det(f0::vec((a(1), a(2)), (b(1), b(2))), f0::vec((a(1), a(2)), (s(1), s(2)))) = f0::det(f0::vec(a, b), f0::vec(a, s))
        release thm det_of_vectors_coordinates_17(a, b, a, s)
        (a(1), a(2))(1) = a(1)
        (a(1), a(2))(2) = a(2)
        (b(1), b(2))(1) = b(1)
        (b(1), b(2))(2) = b(2)
        (s(1), s(2))(1) = s(1)
        (s(1), s(2))(2) = s(2)
        release thm det_of_vectors_coordinates_17((a(1), a(2)), (b(1), b(2)), (a(1), a(2)), (s(1), s(2)))
        release thm subtraction_congruence_17((b(1), b(2))(1), b(1), (a(1), a(2))(1), a(1))
        (b(1), b(2))(1) - (a(1), a(2))(1) = b(1) - a(1)
        release thm subtraction_congruence_17((b(1), b(2))(2), b(2), (a(1), a(2))(2), a(2))
        (b(1), b(2))(2) - (a(1), a(2))(2) = b(2) - a(2)
        release thm subtraction_congruence_17((s(1), s(2))(1), s(1), (a(1), a(2))(1), a(1))
        (s(1), s(2))(1) - (a(1), a(2))(1) = s(1) - a(1)
        release thm subtraction_congruence_17((s(1), s(2))(2), s(2), (a(1), a(2))(2), a(2))
        (s(1), s(2))(2) - (a(1), a(2))(2) = s(2) - a(2)
        release thm multiplication_congruence_17((b(1), b(2))(1) - (a(1), a(2))(1), b(1) - a(1), (s(1), s(2))(2) - (a(1), a(2))(2), s(2) - a(2))
        ((b(1), b(2))(1) - (a(1), a(2))(1)) * ((s(1), s(2))(2) - (a(1), a(2))(2)) = (b(1) - a(1)) * (s(2) - a(2))
        release thm multiplication_congruence_17((b(1), b(2))(2) - (a(1), a(2))(2), b(2) - a(2), (s(1), s(2))(1) - (a(1), a(2))(1), s(1) - a(1))
        ((b(1), b(2))(2) - (a(1), a(2))(2)) * ((s(1), s(2))(1) - (a(1), a(2))(1)) = (b(2) - a(2)) * (s(1) - a(1))
        release thm subtraction_congruence_17(((b(1), b(2))(1) - (a(1), a(2))(1)) * ((s(1), s(2))(2) - (a(1), a(2))(2)), (b(1) - a(1)) * (s(2) - a(2)), ((b(1), b(2))(2) - (a(1), a(2))(2)) * ((s(1), s(2))(1) - (a(1), a(2))(1)), (b(2) - a(2)) * (s(1) - a(1)))
        f0::det(f0::vec((a(1), a(2)), (b(1), b(2))), f0::vec((a(1), a(2)), (s(1), s(2)))) = ((b(1), b(2))(1) - (a(1), a(2))(1)) * ((s(1), s(2))(2) - (a(1), a(2))(2)) - ((b(1), b(2))(2) - (a(1), a(2))(2)) * ((s(1), s(2))(1) - (a(1), a(2))(1)) = (b(1) - a(1)) * (s(2) - a(2)) - (b(2) - a(2)) * (s(1) - a(1)) = f0::det(f0::vec(a, b), f0::vec(a, s))
    thm coordinate_semicircle_side_transport_17:
        ? forall a, b, s, c cart(R, R):
            f0::det(f0::vec(a, b), f0::vec(a, s)) * f0::det(f0::vec(a, b), f0::vec(a, c)) > 0
            =>:
                f0::det(f0::vec((a(1), a(2)), (b(1), b(2))), f0::vec((a(1), a(2)), (s(1), s(2)))) * f0::det(f0::vec((a(1), a(2)), (b(1), b(2))), f0::vec((a(1), a(2)), (c(1), c(2)))) > 0
        release thm coordinate_determinant_value_17(a, b, s)
        release thm coordinate_determinant_value_17(a, b, c)
        release thm multiplication_congruence_17(f0::det(f0::vec((a(1), a(2)), (b(1), b(2))), f0::vec((a(1), a(2)), (s(1), s(2)))), f0::det(f0::vec(a, b), f0::vec(a, s)), f0::det(f0::vec((a(1), a(2)), (b(1), b(2))), f0::vec((a(1), a(2)), (c(1), c(2)))), f0::det(f0::vec(a, b), f0::vec(a, c)))
        f0::det(f0::vec((a(1), a(2)), (b(1), b(2))), f0::vec((a(1), a(2)), (s(1), s(2)))) * f0::det(f0::vec((a(1), a(2)), (b(1), b(2))), f0::vec((a(1), a(2)), (c(1), c(2)))) = f0::det(f0::vec(a, b), f0::vec(a, s)) * f0::det(f0::vec(a, b), f0::vec(a, c)) > 0
    by def $f0::is_midpoint(center_gamma, point_a, point_b)
    by def $f0::is_on_line(point_d, point_a, point_b)
    by def $f0::is_perpendicular(point_c, point_d, point_a, point_b)
    by def $f0::circle_tangent_to_line(center_1, radius_1, line_ab_a, line_ab_b, line_ab_c)
    by def $f0::circle_tangent_to_line(center_2, radius_2, line_ab_a, line_ab_b, line_ab_c)
    by def $f0::circle_tangent_to_line(center_3, radius_3, line_ab_a, line_ab_b, line_ab_c)
    by def $f0::is_on_segment(touch_ab, point_a, point_b)
    by def $f0::is_perpendicular(center_1, touch_ab, point_a, point_b)
    by def $f0::is_on_segment(touch_bc, point_b, point_c)
    by def $f0::is_perpendicular(center_1, touch_bc, point_b, point_c)
    by def $f0::is_on_segment(touch_ca, point_c, point_a)
    by def $f0::is_perpendicular(center_1, touch_ca, point_c, point_a)
    by def $f0::circle_tangent_to_line(center_2, radius_2, line_cd_a, line_cd_b, line_cd_c)
    by def $f0::circle_tangent_to_line(center_3, radius_3, line_cd_a, line_cd_b, line_cd_c)
    by def $f0::circle_internally_tangent_to_semicircle(center_2, radius_2, center_gamma, radius_gamma, point_a, point_b, point_c)
    by def $f0::circle_internally_tangent_to_semicircle(center_3, radius_3, center_gamma, radius_gamma, point_a, point_b, point_c)
    by def $f0::circles_internally_tangent(center_2, radius_2, center_gamma, radius_gamma)
    by def $f0::circles_internally_tangent(center_3, radius_3, center_gamma, radius_gamma)
    release thm squared_distance_coordinates_17(center_gamma, point_a)
    f0::distance_sq(center_gamma, point_a) = (point_a(1) - center_gamma(1)) ^ 2 + (point_a(2) - center_gamma(2)) ^ 2
    release thm midpoint_radius_gives_diameter_17(point_a(1), point_a(2), point_b(1), point_b(2), center_gamma(1), center_gamma(2), radius_gamma)
    release thm diameter_direction_basis_17(point_a(1), point_a(2), point_b(1), point_b(2), radius_gamma)
    obtain ex, ey, fx, fy from exist ex, ey, fx, fy R st {ex ^ 2 + ey ^ 2 = 1, fx ^ 2 + fy ^ 2 = 1, ex * fx + ey * fy = 0, point_b(1) - point_a(1) = 2 * radius_gamma * ex, point_b(2) - point_a(2) = 2 * radius_gamma * ey, fx = -ey, fy = ex}
    release thm on_line_zero_determinant_17(point_d, point_a, point_b)
    f0::det(f0::vec(point_a, point_d), f0::vec(point_a, point_b)) = 0
    release thm det_of_vectors_coordinates_17(point_a, point_d, point_a, point_b)
    f0::det(f0::vec(point_a, point_d), f0::vec(point_a, point_b)) = (point_d(1) - point_a(1)) * (point_b(2) - point_a(2)) - (point_d(2) - point_a(2)) * (point_b(1) - point_a(1))
    release thm multiplication_congruence_17(point_d(1) - point_a(1), point_d(1) - point_a(1), point_b(2) - point_a(2), 2 * radius_gamma * ey)
    (point_d(1) - point_a(1)) * (point_b(2) - point_a(2)) = (point_d(1) - point_a(1)) * 2 * radius_gamma * ey
    release thm multiplication_congruence_17(point_d(2) - point_a(2), point_d(2) - point_a(2), point_b(1) - point_a(1), 2 * radius_gamma * ex)
    (point_d(2) - point_a(2)) * (point_b(1) - point_a(1)) = (point_d(2) - point_a(2)) * 2 * radius_gamma * ex
    release thm subtraction_congruence_17((point_d(1) - point_a(1)) * (point_b(2) - point_a(2)), (point_d(1) - point_a(1)) * 2 * radius_gamma * ey, (point_d(2) - point_a(2)) * (point_b(1) - point_a(1)), (point_d(2) - point_a(2)) * 2 * radius_gamma * ex)
    (point_d(1) - point_a(1)) * (point_b(2) - point_a(2)) - (point_d(2) - point_a(2)) * (point_b(1) - point_a(1)) = (point_d(1) - point_a(1)) * 2 * radius_gamma * ey - (point_d(2) - point_a(2)) * 2 * radius_gamma * ex
    (point_d(1) - point_a(1)) * 2 * radius_gamma * ey - (point_d(2) - point_a(2)) * 2 * radius_gamma * ex = 2 * radius_gamma * ((point_d(1) - point_a(1)) * ey - (point_d(2) - point_a(2)) * ex)
    2 * radius_gamma * ((point_d(1) - point_a(1)) * ey - (point_d(2) - point_a(2)) * ex) = 0
    2 * radius_gamma > 0
    2 * radius_gamma != 0
    by contra:
        ? (point_d(1) - point_a(1)) * ey - (point_d(2) - point_a(2)) * ex = 0
        (point_d(1) - point_a(1)) * ey - (point_d(2) - point_a(2)) * ex != 0
        2 * radius_gamma * ((point_d(1) - point_a(1)) * ey - (point_d(2) - point_a(2)) * ex) != 0
        impossible 2 * radius_gamma * ((point_d(1) - point_a(1)) * ey - (point_d(2) - point_a(2)) * ex) = 0
    (point_d(1) - point_a(1)) * ey - (point_d(2) - point_a(2)) * ex = 0
    release thm diameter_collinear_split_17(point_a(1), point_a(2), point_b(1), point_b(2), point_d(1), point_d(2), ex, ey, radius_gamma)
    obtain p, q from exist p, q R st {point_d(1) - point_a(1) = p * ex, point_d(2) - point_a(2) = p * ey, point_b(1) - point_d(1) = q * ex, point_b(2) - point_d(2) = q * ey, p + q = 2 * radius_gamma}
    release thm dot_of_vectors_coordinates_17(point_c, point_d, point_a, point_b)
    f0::dot(f0::vec(point_c, point_d), f0::vec(point_a, point_b)) = (point_d(1) - point_c(1)) * (point_b(1) - point_a(1)) + (point_d(2) - point_c(2)) * (point_b(2) - point_a(2))
    release thm multiplication_congruence_17(point_d(1) - point_c(1), point_d(1) - point_c(1), point_b(1) - point_a(1), 2 * radius_gamma * ex)
    (point_d(1) - point_c(1)) * (point_b(1) - point_a(1)) = (point_d(1) - point_c(1)) * 2 * radius_gamma * ex
    release thm multiplication_congruence_17(point_d(2) - point_c(2), point_d(2) - point_c(2), point_b(2) - point_a(2), 2 * radius_gamma * ey)
    (point_d(2) - point_c(2)) * (point_b(2) - point_a(2)) = (point_d(2) - point_c(2)) * 2 * radius_gamma * ey
    release thm addition_congruence_17((point_d(1) - point_c(1)) * (point_b(1) - point_a(1)), (point_d(1) - point_c(1)) * 2 * radius_gamma * ex, (point_d(2) - point_c(2)) * (point_b(2) - point_a(2)), (point_d(2) - point_c(2)) * 2 * radius_gamma * ey)
    (point_d(1) - point_c(1)) * (point_b(1) - point_a(1)) + (point_d(2) - point_c(2)) * (point_b(2) - point_a(2)) = (point_d(1) - point_c(1)) * 2 * radius_gamma * ex + (point_d(2) - point_c(2)) * 2 * radius_gamma * ey
    (point_d(1) - point_c(1)) * 2 * radius_gamma * ex + (point_d(2) - point_c(2)) * 2 * radius_gamma * ey = 2 * radius_gamma * ((point_d(1) - point_c(1)) * ex + (point_d(2) - point_c(2)) * ey)
    2 * radius_gamma * ((point_d(1) - point_c(1)) * ex + (point_d(2) - point_c(2)) * ey) = 0
    by contra:
        ? (point_d(1) - point_c(1)) * ex + (point_d(2) - point_c(2)) * ey = 0
        (point_d(1) - point_c(1)) * ex + (point_d(2) - point_c(2)) * ey != 0
        2 * radius_gamma * ((point_d(1) - point_c(1)) * ex + (point_d(2) - point_c(2)) * ey) != 0
        impossible 2 * radius_gamma * ((point_d(1) - point_c(1)) * ex + (point_d(2) - point_c(2)) * ey) = 0
    release thm reverse_difference_dot_zero_17(ex, ey, point_c(1), point_c(2), point_d(1), point_d(2))
    ex * (point_c(1) - point_d(1)) + ey * (point_c(2) - point_d(2)) = 0
    release thm distinct_points_positive_distance_sq_17(point_c, point_d)
    release thm oriented_perpendicular_components_17(ex, ey, point_c(1) - point_d(1), point_c(2) - point_d(2))
    obtain nx, ny, h from exist nx, ny, h R st {nx ^ 2 + ny ^ 2 = 1, ex * nx + ey * ny = 0, h > 0, point_c(1) - point_d(1) = h * nx, point_c(2) - point_d(2) = h * ny}
    release thm affine_coordinates_17(point_a(1), point_a(2), point_b(1), point_b(2), point_c(1), point_c(2), point_d(1), point_d(2), ex, ey, nx, ny, p, q, h)
    release thm diameter_circle_equation_in_frame_17(point_a, point_b, point_c, point_d, center_gamma, ex, ey, nx, ny, p, q, h, radius_gamma)
    ((p - q) / 2) ^ 2 + h ^ 2 = radius_gamma ^ 2
    release thm diameter_altitude_product_17(p, q, h, radius_gamma)
    h ^ 2 = p * q
    release thm positive_legs_from_sum_product_17(p, q, h, radius_gamma)
    p > 0
    q > 0
    point_a(1) - (point_d(1) - p * ex) = 0
    (point_a(1) + p * ex) - point_d(1) = point_a(1) - (point_d(1) - p * ex)

    point_d(1) = point_a(1) + p * ex

    release thm orthonormal_coordinate_decomposition_17(center_2(1), center_2(2), point_d(1), point_d(2), ex, ey, nx, ny)
    obtain x_2, y_2 from exist x_2, y_2 R st {center_2(1) = point_d(1) + x_2 * ex + y_2 * nx, center_2(2) = point_d(2) + x_2 * ey + y_2 * ny}
    release thm orthonormal_coordinate_decomposition_17(center_3(1), center_3(2), point_d(1), point_d(2), ex, ey, nx, ny)
    obtain x_3, y_3 from exist x_3, y_3 R st {center_3(1) = point_d(1) + x_3 * ex + y_3 * nx, center_3(2) = point_d(2) + x_3 * ey + y_3 * ny}

    x_2 ^ 2 = radius_2 ^ 2
    y_2 ^ 2 = radius_2 ^ 2
    release thm center_axis_tangency_squares_probe(point_a(1), point_a(2), point_b(1), point_b(2), point_c(1), point_c(2), point_d(1), point_d(2), center_3(1), center_3(2), ex, ey, nx, ny, p, q, h, x_3, y_3, radius_3, line_ab_a, line_ab_b, line_ab_c, line_cd_a, line_cd_b, line_cd_c)
